summary: Base Defence tower defense game testing complete. Fixed critical frontend-backend API mismatch. All UI flows working: lobby loads with upgrades grid, PLAY starts game canvas, game end overlay shows on defeat, CONTINUE returns to lobby. Backend save/load APIs (GET/POST /api/idle-game/state, /api/idle-game/save) working with 100% test pass rate.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - Frontend was using wrong API response key (game_state_json) and wrong endpoint (POST /api/idle-game/state instead of /api/idle-game/save). Corrected to use 'state' key and correct endpoint.

issues: Game balance issue: With base stats (range: 120, attackSpeed: 1.0, damage: 10), enemies can overwhelm the tower quickly resulting in 0 kills in first run. This is a gameplay design choice - permanent upgrades make runs easier.

action_items: IMPORTANT: The fix to page.tsx for API mismatch was applied. Verify the fix works in production.
Consider game balance: Base stats may need tuning - tower starts weak and enemies can quickly overwhelm. Players need to purchase lobby upgrades for better runs.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: page.tsx had 3 API mismatches: 1) Reading 'game_state_json' instead of 'state' from response, 2) POSTing to wrong endpoint (/state instead of /save), 3) Sending 'game_state_json' key instead of 'state'
Game engine implementation is solid with proper enemy spawning, projectile physics, damage calculation, and XP/gold drops
Canvas rendering uses pixel art style correctly with 480x480 internal resolution
Pickup collection uses onPointerDown which works for both mouse and touch
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base Defence is a Sassy Archer-style tower defense game replacing the old Pet Idle. The archer tower auto-shoots arrows at approaching enemies. Key features: 15-minute survival timer, XP gems (green diamonds) and gold coins (yellow circles) drop from kills and must be tapped to collect, level-up with upgrade choices, permanent lobby upgrades. Backend APIs: GET /api/idle-game/state (load), POST /api/idle-game/save (save with {state: GameSave}). Fixed frontend API integration in page.tsx. Game canvas is 480x480 internal resolution with pixel art style. First runs are challenging - lobby upgrades make subsequent runs easier.

mocked_apis.note: All idle game APIs are real - no mocking
